test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Compititor**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelled word is '**Compititor**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Competitor**'. • It means **'a person or organization that is competing against others'.** (प्रतिस्‍पर्धी; प्रतियोगी व्‍यक्ति या संस्‍था) • *Example: There are ten **competitors** in the first race.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Instructor**: a person whose job is to teach a practical skill or sport. (प्रायोगिक कौशल या खेल का शिक्षक) • **Contractor**: a person or company that has a contract to do work or provide goods or services for another company. ((सामान या सेवा देने वाला) ठेकेदार व्‍यक्ति या कंपनी) • **Prosecutor**: a public official who charges somebody with a crime and tries to show that he/she is guilty in a court of law. (अदालत में किसी पर अपराध के लिए अभियोग लगाने वाला सरकारी अधिकारी; अभियोजक) 39:Tabd, The correct answer is '**severe**'.
